description: Fetch the article stream under a TechCrunch topic/company tag — the same list shown on tag pages like techcrunch.com/tag/apple/. Tags are TechCrunch's free-form labels, mostly company, people, and product names (apple, openai, spacex, elon-musk...), distinct from the 23 fixed editorial categories in techcrunch/get-feed. The topic parameter is the tag slug from the tag page URL; you can also copy slugs from the tags field returned by techcrunch/get-article. Returns the tag's total article count plus article cards (title, URL, date, excerpt, featured image, categories). Paginates internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when the stream is exhausted. No authentication required.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: Tag slug as it appears in tag page URLs: techcrunch.com/tag/{slug}/ (e.g. "apple", "openai", "cloud-computing"). Lowercase, words joined with hyphens. Discovery: open any article and check its tag links, or use the tags array from techcrunch/get-article.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates internally; partial=true when the tag stream is exhausted.
